role: already viewed development comparison; not held out
hypothesis: Allow a finer measured level to recover a coarse-only support/conditioning/increment failure, without relaxing finest or final admission.
change: Only fit() differs from the frozen patch-normal engine; all other code and thresholds remain unchanged

factor.source: raw axial depth; original vertices and pyramid decimation; nearest target pixel; local patch normals
factor.selection: unchanged pair-selection code, but measured-normal validity and orientation change the selected candidates
factor.normal: n=(ns+nt)/L, L=norm(ns+nt), both normals in first optical-camera coordinates
factor.target_jacobian: negative source Jacobian, including both normal-rotation effects
factor.robust: Huber0.01m, at least200 samples per pair
factor.prior: same incident-only Schur elimination, fixed-anchor coordinate transport and unique factor identities

normal_estimator.covariance: population covariance of eligible vertex offsets to center; no smoothing of center vertices

normal_controls.oracle: independent centered patch SVD; only original depth, vertices and intrinsics shared
fixtures: Gaussian axial-depth noise sigma0.002m seed421016; same-pixel median and p95 angle compared to truth

scheduling.skip_action: record independently checkable system and proposal; apply no update; retain preceding admitted iterations; advance once to next finer level
